'''Elinde Motheneos''' was a leader in northern [[Esandara]] during the rise of [[Artur Hawkwing]] who followed the [[False Dragon]], [[Guaire Amalasan]].

== History ==
She was an expert in siege warfare. According to some accounts, she was a renegade [[Aes Sedai]], but it is considered an unverifiable rumor that often surrounds historical accounts.

In {{fy|943}}, after Amalasan was captured, she joined with [[Sawyn Maculhene]], capturing at least two of the [[Alindrelle Erinin]] bridges and attacking the [[White Tower]]. She was defeated, and was either killed in battle or executed.{{ref/book|bwb|11}}
